# Samoa

> [!summary] Data available
> No food data, but the largest Pacific ethnobotany set in [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 644 records (149 taxa; wounds, fever, eye, sores; noni *Morinda citrifolia*, *Premna taitensis*, coconut). Also [[NPASS]] (1 pair) and [[KNApSAcK Family]]. Compounds via [[Global]].
